artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan: timeout-minutes parity on ci.yml's build job (deliverable b), documentation of lean-action's default-on .lake cache and its per-job save boundary, and a final verification/summary phase; filed deliverable (a) deliberately not implemented per research's live-evidence reversal.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a plan's Tier Justification, resolve suite_selection_select PER PHASE over that phase's own 'Files to modify' set, never over a union of all candidate paths. The selector collapses a mixed set to the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel as soon as ONE path has no mapped suite, which masks the real suites the other paths map to. Measured instance: passing '.github/workflows/ci.yml', 'lakefile.toml' and 'docs/development/CI_CD_PROCESS.md' together returned __FULL_SWEEP__, while ci.yml alone returned test-lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh and lakefile.toml alone returned six real suites. A per-phase resolution is both honest and what validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement check actually compares against -- it flags a sentinel claim for a phase whose own paths map to real suites.
